subject: Q3 Gate: OKR launch, owners & go/no-go checklist
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: maya.srinivasan@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: qbr-admin@partners.example.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 Gate: OKR launch, owners & go/no-go checklist

Team —

Attached is version 3 of the Q3 OKR slate (Q3_OKR-draft-v3.xlsx). This is the working packet for the quarter gate and the QBR packet; please treat it as the single source of truth for owner assignments and acceptance. Key asks: 

- Owners: Please confirm ownership and acceptance of the metric (type "ACK <name>") by EOD tomorrow (2027-07-01).
- Risks: Call out any blockers that would impact delivery before you ACK (hiring, infra, timelines).
- Measurement: Where metric definitions are ambiguous I’ve added a footnote; propose measurement text inline if you disagree.
- QBR artifacts: Link to the packet is below; we’ll finalize the executive one-pager after owners ACK.

High-level notes: We moved the Serving reliability objective to be capacity-driven (we need a resource note from Karthik). Maya, I flagged the evaluation workload you asked for under "Latency & P95" — please confirm the traces to include.

Files attached: Q3_OKR-draft-v3.xlsx (sheet: owners, metrics, risks).

Thanks — short thread, please.

Dylan Brooks
Head of Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Gate: OKR launch, owners & go/no-go checklist

ACK Maya Srinivasan (I’ve added two small edits and inline comments; see attachment okr_comments-maya.pdf). Primary suggestions:

- For "Serving: reduce p95 latency" — clarify measurement window (I propose 3m rolling p95 during business hours).
- For "Cost per 1k tokens" metric — split for streaming vs non-streaming to avoid conflating workloads.

On the evaluation traces: I confirm we should include both "median payload" and an "edge-case payload" set. I left a comment on the owners sheet asking that CS provide the customer example for the edge case.

Thanks,
Maya
Sr. Product Manager, Serving
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, qbr-admin@partners.example.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 14:20:47 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Gate: OKR launch, owners & go/no-go checklist

Thanks Dylan — quick operational note: the rollout plan in the doc assumes we can run the A/B ramp on Dedicated pools starting week 3. That requires the autoscale policy change we discussed with infra (REQ-1423-rollout-notes). I’ve put a brief staging checklist in the doc linked below. If Karthik can confirm GPU capacity we can keep the timeline; if not we should push the serving objective by one week to avoid a noisy launch.

Link: doc:REQ-1423-rollout-notes

Also tagging a small procurement ask: there’s one reserved instance refresh due in early August that may change cost baselines — I will capture the delta and update the cost metric if it looks material.

-priyom
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

ACK Laura Bennett. I reviewed the doc and the edits from Maya look sensible. I approve the slate contingent on Karthik confirming the capacity note Priyom flagged. Once Karthik confirms, I’ll sign the executive one-pager and loop in Growth for their brief.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 16:05:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Gate: OKR launch, owners & go/no-go checklist

ACK Karthik Iyer. Capacity confirmation: we can support the week-3 A/B ramp on Dedicated with the following caveats (see capacity_allocation_schedule.csv attached):

- We will allocate an incremental 12% reserved pool to Serving for the first six weeks of the quarter; that will hold p95 target while we run the ramp.
- Procurement note: the reserved instance refresh Priyom called out will add ~1.6% to run-rate if filled; will provide a final delta by next Monday.
- Owners list: I confirm resource commitments for the owners column as listed; if any owner sees a mismatch please highlight before EOD Friday (2027-07-02).

With that confirmation, this slate is approved for the QBR packet. Dylan — please merge the final doc and I’ll forward to Finance for run-rate capture.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Infrastructure & Ops
Redwood Inference
